create.name: Shakti Shala
create.bio:
Shakti Shala is a yoga studio in the colonial town of Antigua, Guatemala, that grew out of free weekly classes held in Tanque La Unión park in 2016 and opened its own room in 2017. Its practice draws on the Ashtanga lineage: a daily Mysore programme sits at the centre of the timetable, alongside led Ashtanga, Rocket and Vinyasa classes, with gentler slow-flow and candlelight sessions for newcomers. Lauren McKiddy, who co-founded the studio and has taught in Antigua for about ten years, leads it with a bilingual team teaching in English and Spanish, and authorised Ashtanga teachers are among its staff.

Beyond the daily classes, the studio keeps a monthly round of community gatherings, including kirtan and breathwork, plus a weekly free meditation. It hosts visiting Ashtanga teachers for immersions, and it runs its own 200-hour hybrid teacher training in Ashtanga and Vinyasa: a self-paced online stage followed by two weeks in person in Antigua, covering philosophy, anatomy, pranayama, sequencing and the craft of teaching, with Lauren McKiddy and Silvana Vanfretti leading a small faculty of guest teachers.

courses.title: Shakti Shala 200HR Yoga Teacher Training 2027
courses.description: A hybrid 200-hour training in Ashtanga and Vinyasa: online self-study opens in March 2027, then the cohort meets at the studio in Antigua for fifteen days. Daily practice runs alongside teaching labs, sequencing, pranayama, meditation, philosophy and a final practicum.
courses.price: $1,950 USD (early bird to 15 January 2027); $2,200 USD full tuition

courses.title: 5-Day Adaptive Ashtanga Yoga Immersion
courses.description: Five days of led and Mysore-style Ashtanga with visiting teachers Christiane Coste Cacho and Brendan Smullen, with pranayama, journaling and afternoon workshops on transitions, backbends and hip opening. Taught in English and Spanish; open to all levels.

courses.title: Classes and packages
courses.description: Drop-in classes and class packages for the daily timetable: Mysore, led Ashtanga, Rocket, Vinyasa, slow flow, candlelight flow and meditation. Packages are bought through the studio's online booking catalogue.
